content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a timer function available which pauses the remaining time when the trigger is off, and resumes counting when the trigger is activated again? I assumed a retentive timer would work this way, but it only appears to save the time value when the [product_name] device is powered off.
No, such a block does not exist in this system. You could create one yourself; see the attached image for reference.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking a timer feature in the [product_name] system that can pause and resume based on the trigger state, believing a retentive timer should function this way. The user realizes the built-in timer only retains its value during power loss, and another participant confirms that this specific functionality is not available, revealing a gap between user needs and current product features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] system to have a timer block capable of pausing and continuing timing depending on the trigger state, rather than merely saving the time when powered off.
